25.content:
Following are the Disadvantage of Data Flow Diagram (DFD) :
1. Can be time-consuming: Creating DFDs can be a time-consuming process, especially for
complex systems.
2. Limited focus: DFDs focus primarily on the flow of data in a system, and may not capture
other important aspects of the system, such as user interface design, system security, or
system performance.
3. Can be difficult to keep up-to-date: DFDs may become out-of-date over time as the system
evolves and changes.
